notes.title: Sale + New Things
notes.content:
Hi!

Firework Simulator is in the Steam Sale and there's also an update with some new things.

[h3]Additions[/h3]

[b]Camera Shake[/b]
The camera will now shake when you are hit by some fireworks (e.g. explosions). Also it will shake differently depending on the location of the firework.

[b]Window Mode Settings[/b]
Instead of the Windowed Toggle, in the settings you can now select between different window modes:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43478282/ae4810dba2c8ea2743fe53512b56583bd28ded23.png[/img]

[h3]UI Adjustments[/h3]

Redid a bunch of UI Sounds that were too loud/soft.

Redid the mission graphics, if the mission isn't complete it will show an unexploded firework and if they are then it will explode:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43478282/7d067c4aa290f8434f5a971927cf0c24fd905f56.png[/img]

There are some more adjustments/fixes but they aren't very notable.
[spoiler]Didn't keep track of them.[/spoiler]

notes.title: New Area - So-Sigh City
notes.content:
A new area has been added!

[h1]So-Sigh City[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43478282/f124964282b68006fb996680eec9c8f22b77ca5a.png[/img]

It's a big, open area with tall buildings with an empty warehouse-type structure.

You don't need to do anything special to unlock it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43478282/53a33db1d3397d59e6d8537eee6898f25fe0c3f1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43478282/b55bdd7b327be8d5b01bded46f5fd72baf9a4965.png[/img]

This is to go along with this:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3362340/Survive_Society/

notes.title: Sale + Upcoming Things
notes.content:
First off, sale! [b]50% off![/b]

It will also be in the Summer Sale, believe it's for the same amount, not going to open another tab to check, you think this is some kind of open a second tab to check on sale percentages operation? HA

Also just happens to be that the Fourth of July is coming up too, what great timing!

[h1]PREVIEWS[/h1]

Second, preview of upcoming things, which include new fireworks, powders and an area.

[h3]Smoke Bomb[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43478282/e4cdcb767282b52c7ab5c60d32f10c320fb4ed2e.png[/img]
It releases colored smoke. This will also include a new [b]Smoke [/b]powder for crafting, you'll be able to choose the color and whether or not it will go off instantly or wait.

[h3]Whistler[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43478282/8d2b9bc69b6a301298858c7985d1af5b13db6d8e.png[/img]
Makes a loud whistling sound which too will be available as a powder for crafting: [b]Whistle[/b]. It can be continuous or a burst so it can make noise while traveling or burst after traveling. (Or both?!)

[h3]New Area – Neighborhood[/h3]
Have a new area planned that will have a street, houses (with interiors) and a nearby forest. The base layout has been started:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43478282/a04e26d767a66a7510681c226f04311c2013d4f7.jpg[/img][i]Seen here in Blender[/i]

Might just add pre-made houses instead of modeling new ones because they can be difficult to model to look good.

These should release when this game does:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1992650/Second_Dreamer/

The smoke bomb and whistler fireworks are from this game and also play a part in some of the puzzles and the neighborhood map is based on the street here:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43478282/871705db85f045a2619b1b5abd4beaae4e827f51.jpg[/img]

It also has a firework tent in the city with lots of fireworks to mess around with:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43478282/b54db284ea4bac24735e1759a1bc0d156606e87f.jpg[/img]

So there should be a big update when Second Dreamer releases it has just been a nightmare to bug test.

[h2]OTHER IDEAS[/h2]

Ideas for possible other fireworks:
[list]
[*][b]Parachute[/b]: Shoots in the air then floats down with a parachute.
[*][b]Snake[/b]: You know those tiny discs that you light on fire and they turn into snake like ash.
[*][b]Handheld Sparklers[/b]
[*][b]Different mortars[/b] (along with being able to craft your own)
[/list]
Also looked around at firework tents (irl) and got more ideas. Bought this Frog firework and will test it out to see what it does, it better be awesome.

OK THATS IT FOR THIS ANNOUNCEMENT
[h1]HAPPY JULY FOURTH!![/h1]

notes.title: New Firework - Dung Ball
notes.content:
New firework - The [b]Dung Ball[/b] has been added!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43478282/f59f49a43bc2fdd5adfea12f1bc1d09223271862.png[/img]

After updating the game it will be on the bottom shelf of the firework stand.
It rolls around when active. Here's a video of it in action:

[url=https://twitter.com/Echomune/status/1737573995258819025]https://twitter.com/Echomune/status/1737573995258819025[/url]

This is for Ball of Poo (featuring Dung Beetle-Chan) where you play as Dung Beetle-Chan and roll around on a ball of poo.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2683180/Ball_of_Poo/

[h3]Fixes and Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Made the Challenges selection fancier.
[*] Increased the lighting/brightness in the firework stand.
[*] Fixed a bug where the pop-ups won't disappear and stay there forever.
[*] Fixed not being able to select fireworks from certain positions in the firework stand.
[*] Fixed the roman candle sometimes lagging behind when held.
[/list]

notes.content:
[h2]New Firework[/h2]

There's a new firework available, it's on the bottom shelf in the firework stand next to the capybara. 

👻 The Haunted House 👻

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43478282/0d5d50d74a7ac03de47b8dc519c84c2019b0e1a2.png[/img]

This one is sort of similar to the Missiles firework but shoots flares with Halloween colors.

Based on Haunted House Builder:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2626180/Haunted_House_Builder/

Just update the game and it will be in the firework stand on the bottom shelf.

[h2]Demo Available[/h2]

There's a demo for Firework Simulator now. It has a selection of fireworks to try out and the Alley map.

[h2]Fixes[/h2]

- Fixed selection issues in the firework stand where you couldn't select right or left.

notes.title: Making your own Fireworks
notes.content:
In Firework Simulator you might see one of these:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43478282/875aa708c09f4c5f4659e37962feb171854322e7.png[/img]

It's a construction stand where you can make fireworks! This is what the menu looks like:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43478282/6950804d10c7a6addfb7f6ffc039b792ec0b8eb6.jpg[/img]

[h2]CONTAINERS[/h2]

You'll be able to pick from several different containers, each one is different and holds different amounts and types of powders.

For example the helicopter container will fly better than the others, the roman candle lets you hold it while it's active and the seven barrel container can have 7 different things going on at once.

Some containers are initially locked, you'll have to figure out how to unlock them. (à la Smash Bros)

[h2]POWDERS[/h2]

Here are the different powders you can add:
[list]
[*][b]Spin [/b]- Causes firework to spin
[*][b]Jet [/b]- Propels firework in a direction
[*][b]Sparkles [/b]- A stream of colorful sparks
[*][b]Crackles [/b]- A stream of popping sparks
[*][b]Explode [/b]- It explodes
[*][b]Pop Sparkle [/b]- A burst of sparks
[*][b]Pop Crackle [/b]- A burst of popping sparks
[*][b]Paper Ball [/b]- Paper Balls are unique as they can hold two different powders and will shoot in the direction of the container. Powders you can add are Flares, Sparkles, Crackles and Pops
[/list]
You'll be able to color all powders except for Crackles and Explode, they have a set color.

If you set a powder to Instant it will go off when the firework first activates otherwise they will go in order. Once it hits the explosion powder that will set off all others though.

An example video of how some of it works:

[previewyoutube=1Kfuk17qVJM;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
